text: A scroll saw has a thin blade for small, curvy cuts.
The table holds the wood while the blade moves.
Hold the wood flat on the table with your fingers to the side of the blade.

tip.text: Keep the hold-down foot on the wood. Fingers never go in front of the blade.

text: Turn the wood slowly to follow your line.
For a tight corner, cut into it, back out, and come from another side.

tip.text: Practice on a scrap with a drawn wavy line.
